versions.changelog:
Kalshi Crypto Monotonicity Trader 1.0.0 — initial release:

- Enforces monotonicity constraints between adjacent crypto price-level "above $X" markets on Kalshi.
- Automatically detects and trades on violations by buying undervalued lower thresholds and selling overvalued higher thresholds.
- Risk parameters, trade limits, and thresholds fully adjustable via Simmer UI.
- Supports BTC and ETH markets; requires SIMMER_API_KEY and simmer-sdk.
- Runs in paper trading mode by default; live trading requires explicit --live flag.
